articles.title: PSA: Patch your Plex media server before someone hacks it
articles.summary:
Recently fixed vulnerabilities in the Plex Media Server are under active exploitation in attacks that, when successful, install malware, including cryptominers and residential proxy apps, a researcher said.
Plex fixed four vulnerabilities at the start of last month. Three weeks later, published CVE designations revealed five vulnerabilities, with one of them carrying a severity rating of 8.6 out of 10. A researcher last week revealed an exploit that chained four of them together to achieve remote code execution of the device running a vulnerable Plex version. The researcher named the chain “Plex2Shell.”
Complex exploit chain
The new details allowed a separate researcher to create a honeypot that could track attempts in the wild to exploit the vulnerability chain. Within a day, the researcher began seeing active scanning of the simulated Plex server and eventually successful attempts to infect devices. So far, successful attacks are installing two payloads. One is a cryptominer, which uses the device to mine cryptocurrency and deposit it into a wallet controlled by the attacker. The other payload is residential proxy software, which allows people to anonymize their Internet activity (much of it illegal) by connecting to the infected box and then using it to send the user’s traffic to a final destination.
“Plex may be hosted on residential IP [sic] and I think threat actors would love to have residential IP proxy to access corporate VPNs and emails,” the second researcher wrote…

Le 18 octobre 2026, sur sa piste d’essai de Sano, au nord de Tokyo, le constructeur japonais a montré un prototype étrennant sa future plateforme électrique. Jusqu’ici, toutes les Subaru électriques ont été développées avec Toyota. Une dépendance industrielle que Subaru aimerait bien voir disparaitre.
D’après Automotive News, présent sur place, la marque déploiera ses premières technologies maison à partir de 2029 environ, sans préciser sur quel modèle. « En développant nos véhicules en interne et en disposant de nos propres technologies en matière de véhicules électriques, nous pouvons rapidement offrir à nos clients la tranquillité d’esprit et le plaisir de conduite qui caractérisent Subaru, même en cette période de changement », explique Takatomo Watamori, directeur exécutif en charge de l’ingénierie.
Une Subaru électrique faite maison, avec Aisin, Panasonic et AMD
Pour l’instant, la nouvelle plateforme roule sous une carrosserie d’Outback. Researchers at Argonne National Laboratory and the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign published a technical paper titled “Agentic AI for Heterogeneous System Design Across Chip, Scale-Up, and Scale-Out Domains.”
Abstract Excerpt:
“The design space of modern AI/HPC systems has expanded rapidly across compute architectures, including GPUs, dataflow processors, and RISC-V accelerators; memory technologies, including HBM, GDDR, and SRAM; and interconnects such as NVLink, UALink, Infinity Fabric, InfiniBand, Slingshot, and Ultra Ethernet. No single architecture is optimal across LLM training, LLM serving, and AI-coupled HPC workloads, while the resulting combinatorial design space is too large for manual exploration. We present ArchAgent, a hierarchical multi- agent framework in which an LLM-based planner decomposes system design into chip, scale-up, and scale-out subproblems, each handled by specialist agents.”

articles.title: Fortanix extends Confidential AI to Kubernetes workloads through Confidential Containers - SiliconANGLE

Fortanix extends Confidential AI to Kubernetes workloads through Confidential Containers
Data security company Fortanix Inc. today extended its Fortanix Confidential AI platform to support the Cloud Native Computing Foundation’s Confidential Containers project, so enterprises can run artificial intelligence workloads on Kubernetes inside hardware-based trusted execution environments.
The release goes after the exposure that comes during inference, when model weights and the data fed to them have to be decrypted in processor memory. Privileged administrators and cloud operators with access to the infrastructure can potentially reach them at that point.
Fortanix published survey figures last week on how AI leaders view that risk. Atomik Research polled 300 of them at large U.S. companies on Fortanix’s behalf, and 93% said traditional encryption does not protect data while AI is processing it. articles.title: OVHcloud : un pirate a glissé un logiciel espion dans plusieurs versions de son outil en ligne de commande officiel

Hier, si vous avez installé l’outil en ligne de commande d’OVHcloud depuis GitHub entre 14h47 et 16h21, alors vous avez récupéré un programme conçu pour fouiller votre disque à la recherche de secrets. Et effacer l’exécutable ne vous protège pas, il faut changer toutes les clés stockées sur la machine.
Six semaines après avoir décroché la qualification SecNumCloud pour son cloud public, OVHcloud a subi une attaque par la chaîne d’approvisionnement. Le pirate n’est jamais entré dans ses centres de données. Il a piégé ovhcloud, l’outil avec lequel développeurs et administrateurs pilotent leurs serveurs depuis un terminal, et les utilisateurs ont récupéré le fichier vérolé sur les pages officielles du projet. « La version CLI de 14h47 a été compromise par un hacker », a prévenu Octave Klaba, fondateur d’OVHcloud, sur son compte X. Cinq versions, de la 0.11.0 à la 0.15.0, sont concernées, mais la méthode d’installation compte davantage que le numéro de version pour savoir si vous êtes exposé.
Des fichiers remplacés des semaines après leur publication
Le pirate n’a touché ni au code source ni à la chaîne de compilation. Octave Klaba évoque le compte GitHub « d’un des développeurs ». D’après la chronologie reconstituée par OpenSourceMalware, ce compte appartient à un contributeur de la documentation d’OVHcloud, doté des droits d’écriture sur le dépôt de l’outil. Comme toute liaison sans fil, elle passe par des ondes radio : il faut donc lui réserver des fréquences bien précises. En l’espèce, les fréquences en jeu se trouvent dans la bande des 2 GHz, la même dans toute l’Union européenne. Une bande décrite comme « idéale » par la Commission européenne.

Un neurone qui s'allumait devant une tête de chat comme devant une calandre de voiture a longtemps servi de preuve que l'IA serait indéchiffrable. L'un des chercheurs qui avaient forgé cette lecture la démolit aujourd'hui dans un essai fleuve, chiffres à l'appui, et la communauté se divise déjà.
Depuis des années, la recherche répète que les grands modèles d'IA échappent à leurs propres concepteurs. Le 15 octobre, Nick Cammarata, chercheur chez Goodfire, laboratoire spécialisé dans l'interprétabilité, a publié Neural Networks Are Already Clean, un essai d'une heure de lecture qui prend ce dogme à rebours. Coauteur en 2020 de Zoom In avec Chris Olah, il a contribué à installer la théorie qu'il conteste désormais. En 2023, le projet d'interprétabilité automatisée qu'il avait lancé chez OpenAI ne jugeait lisibles qu'environ 1,7 % des neurones.
	
Je crois avoir une bonne nouvelle sur la nature des réseaux de neurones.
Le fameux neurone "chat-voiture" détectait en réalité des formes en V

L'explication admise, la superposition, voulait qu'un réseau à court de neurones entasse des notions sans rapport. articles.title: Russian spacecraft maneuvers in "extreme proximity" to satellite used by Ukraine
articles.summary:
A Russian military satellite maneuvered in “extreme proximity” of a commercial Earth-imaging satellite in recent days in the first known example an unsanctioned rendezvous in low-Earth orbit, according to the orbital intelligence company LeoLabs.
The Russian spacecraft, Kosmos 2612, “conducted a deliberate series of maneuvers toward ICEYE-X36, a US-operated commercial imaging satellite,” LeoLabs said. “Kosmos 2612 closed from hundreds of kilometers away to extreme proximity to ICEYE-X36. It then maneuvered around ICEYE-X36, remained nearby for an extended period, and then began moving away.”
US military officials and independent analysts have tracked Kosmos 2612 since its April launch on a Soyuz rocket from a spaceport in northern Russia. Within weeks, it became apparent that at least four of the six satellites from that launch were stalking ICEYE-X36 after they adjusted orbits to line up with the orbit of the ICEYE spacecraft.
Russia’s modus operandi
The situation remained stable until last week, when Kosmos 2612 began rapidly moving toward ICEYE-X36. By Friday, Kosmos 2612 was holding station 2 to 3 kilometers away before shifting positions ahead of and behind the ICEYE satellite, LeoLabs said. The satellites were within 500 meters (1,640 feet) of one another over the weekend, and “likely quite a bit closer than that,” said Adam Marsh, LeoLabs’ vice president of technical solutions.

articles.title: Canadian publishers launch copyright suit against AI company Anthropic
articles.summary:
A group of Canada’s largest publishers are suing AI company Anthropic in the Ontario court. The publishers, which include Postmedia, Torstar, The Globe and Mail, and the Canadian Press, claim that Anthropic infringed on their copyright by using their content to develop Claude. The lawsuit was filed on Oct. 6, and initially reported by Cartt.
“Anthropic has capitalized on the commercial success of its AI models, building an expansive suite of services, and raised significant capital — all without obtaining a valid licence from any of the News Media Companies,” says the statement of claim.
The claim indicates that Anthropic breached and circumvented the protection measures put in place to prevent copying of their content. Additionally, it says that Anthropic accesses and copies a lot of text data from the internet and the Plaintiff’s websites. Anthropic then allegedly uses that content without authorization or consent to train its AI models. Further, the lawsuit indicates that Anthropic scrapes content on an ongoing basis because of ongoing user prompts.
These publishers have been trying to get the federal government to take a stand on how AI companies use copyrighted content after the national AI strategy failed to address the problem.
The allegations have yet to be proven in court. The same publishers and CBC launched a lawsuit against OpenAI in 2024, which has also not been settled.
Source: Global News

articles.title: Precision Timing Special Report - EE Times
articles.summary:
Every electronic system depends on accurate timing. Crystals and oscillators supply the reference signals that keep processors synchronized, communications stable, and data moving reliably, and nearly every other function on a board is measured against them. A timing device is also among the smallest and least expensive parts in a design, which is why it is often specified late and compared on little more than frequency and price.
That shortcut has become harder to justify. Data rates have climbed, so reference jitter now shows up directly in link margin. Products are deployed where conditions are uncontrolled: on machinery, in vehicles, on utility infrastructure, and inside sealed enclosures. More systems run on batteries for years between service visits, which puts a premium on nanoampere timekeeping. Emissions requirements, safety expectations, and long production lifecycles all push the timing decision earlier in the schedule.
The range of options has widened at the same time. Quartz crystals, packaged clock oscillators, temperature-compensated oscillators, real-time clock modules, MEMS devices, and atomic references each solve a different problem, and several of them look similar in a parametric search. The useful comparison is rarely between technologies in the abstract. It is between a specific device and the requirements of a specific design.

The nearly 9,900-pound (4.5-metric ton) spacecraft—two-thirds of its mass comprised of propellant—separated from the H3 rocket about 71 minutes after liftoff.
Hiroshi Yamakawa, president of the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA), declared the launch a success. “A long journey of five years has just started,” Yamakawa said.

The India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement (FTA), signed on April 27, came into effect on Tuesday, providing duty-free access to a range of Indian goods, including products from labour-intensive sectors such as textiles and leather.

The market opportunity is substantial: McKinsey estimates that AI-powered agents and robots could unlock about $2.9 trillion in annual economic value in the U.S. by 2030. However, realizing this opportunity depends on moving from working prototypes to products that can operate reliably, safely, and economically at scale.
That exposes a different engineering problem. In a prototype, teams can often add more compute, sensors, cooling, or power to prove that a capability works. In deployment, every added capability must fit within the size, weight, power, and cost budget, often abbreviated to SWaP-C, of the system.
Those constraints shape how a robot performs: How long it can operate between charges, how much productive payload it can carry, and how reliably it operates over time. The challenge is not simply adding more intelligence but integrating it effectively into deployable products.
A robot must continuously interpret its surroundings, decide how to respond, and translate those decisions into physical action. Doing that requires capabilities from perception and AI inference to planning and motion control to work together, while meeting different compute and timing requirements.

articles.title: Samsung Taps TSMC for NVHBM Base Die Production
articles.summary:
Monday, October 19th 2026
Samsung Taps TSMC for NVHBM Base Die Production
Samsung is reportedly collaborating with the world's largest chip maker, TSMC, to secure a base die supply for NVIDIA's newly announced NVHBM memory standard. NVHBM integrates the controller into the 3D HBM stack, significantly enhancing performance and efficiency. Compared to standard HBM4E, NVIDIA claims up to 30% more memory bandwidth, 15% lower HBM power consumption, and up to 25% more usable compute die area on the processing unit. In simple terms, NVHBM builds on the standard HBM architecture with base die customization, but there are a few strict requirements that must be fulfilled before mass production.
Interestingly, one of the requirements is that NVIDIA's base die in the NVHBM must be manufactured on TSMC's 3 nm node. articles.title: Chris Lattner: AI Code Generation Doesn't Solve Software Engineering - EE Times
articles.summary:
For AI chip companies, the promise of AI-based coding agents is compelling: generate the low-level kernels needed to get a model running on new hardware, optimize them for performance, and do it without the software engineering resources traditionally required.
But according to Chris Lattner, CEO of AI software startup Modular (recently acquired by Qualcomm, where he now serves as executive VP of software engineering), chip companies should be wary of the limits of AI code generation. Making a kernel run fast is a very different problem from building software infrastructure we can depend on, he told EE Times in an exclusive interview.
“Agents are good, but they’re like anything else; it’s a tool, and you have to use it the right way,” Lattner said. “What I’ve seen with agents is they make tons of throwaway code. So, if you’re building a product, you don’t want to agent-generate everything.”
Agentic code generation makes sense for projects that are well-defined and limited in scope (e.g., “make this kernel go fast”), which can be quantified, measured, and validated, Lattner said, but bigger projects require product design and software engineering and can’t be delegated to agents.
“If you’re a startup and you only care about getting one model working, or getting it to go fast, [then go ahead,] use AI tools to prove it’s possible,” he said. “But that’s not going to be great for when you want to sell your chip to someone else, and they want to run a model you don’t have access to…

Al momento en que el teléfono se queda sin espacio disponible, las aplicaciones pueden presentar fallos, el rendimiento baja y se complican tareas como instalar herramientas nuevas o actualizar el sistema.
En ese escenario, la administración de almacenamiento de WhatsApp permite eliminar archivos acumulados sin borrar los chats, una alternativa que muchos identifican como la “papelera de reciclaje” de la aplicación.
La función no aparece con ese nombre dentro de la plataforma. Está integrada en el apartado de Administración de almacenamiento, desde donde es posible detectar fotos, videos, notas de voz y documentos que ocupan memoria.
La herramienta permite seleccionar contenidos concretos y conservar las conversaciones, incluidos los mensajes de texto que pueden resultar necesarios.
En qué parte está la papelera de reciclaje de WhatsApp
La denominada papelera de reciclaje de WhatsApp se encuentra dentro de los ajustes de la aplicación. Para acceder, hay que abrir el menú de Ajustes, ingresar en Almacenamiento y datos y elegir Administración de almacenamiento. Allí aparece un resumen de los archivos que consumen más memoria en el dispositivo.
El sistema organiza el contenido por tamaño y por conversación. De esa forma, permite localizar con rapidez los videos extensos, las imágenes repetidas, los documentos recibidos hace tiempo o los audios que ya no tienen utilidad. El proceso elimina archivos multimedia, pero no borra el historial de mensajes del chat.

articles.title: MiniMax launches M3.1 Flash model, says it cuts AI agent costs by 70% - SiliconANGLE
articles.summary:
MiniMax launches M3.1 Flash model, says it cuts AI agent costs by 70%
Chinese artificial intelligence developer MiniMax Group Inc. today released M3.1 Flash, a faster and cheaper update to the M3 large language model it launched in June.
The release takes aim at the cost of running AI agents, which often need dozens of model calls to finish a single job. MiniMax said Flash represents its “ongoing exploration of the balance between efficiency and capability.” Agentic tasks cost 70% less to run than on its previous model, the company said, and inference is close to three times as fast, with output at everyday peak topping 200 tokens per second.
Size has barely changed from M3. MiniMax’s developer guide for the preview release lists 428 billion parameters in all, and the launch post credits the extra speed to more aggressive sparsity at inference time. Reasoning stays on for every request, with developers choosing one of five effort levels from Low to Max. The model accepts text, image and video input, and prompts can run to 1 million tokens.
In MiniMax’s own testing, M3.1 Flash scored 61.7 on OSWorld V2, which tests how well a model can operate a computer, and the company said no Chinese model has done better. BankerToolBench, a banking workflow test, gave it 76.2.

Tim Sweeney, director general de Epic Games, afirmó que la inteligencia artificial permitirá desarrollar videojuegos que hasta ahora resultaban imposibles por su costo y por los recursos necesarios para producirlos.

Según fuentes anónimas, el cambio obedecería a una reorganización que llevaría parte del trabajo hacia sistemas de IA.
La información añadió que el objetivo sería reducir la presencia de código realizado por personas y aplicar herramientas automáticas al apartado artístico del proyecto y de futuros desarrollos.
Epic Games apuesta por la IA

articles.title: Panne de train Transdev : ce que les voyageurs peuvent vraiment se faire rembourser
articles.summary:
Après la panne du 9 octobre sur la ligne Marseille-Nice qui a mis des centaines de personnes dans l'embarras, il a fallu éplucher les règles de remboursement des trains ZOU ! exploités par Transdev. Qu'il s'agisse du billet, des frais de taxi ou Uber, les voyageurs ont bien moins de droits qu’ils ne l’imaginent.
[Enquête Clubic, partie 2] Un train Transdev en panne, des heures de retard, un VTC chèrement payé de notre poche, c'est un peu ce que nous avons eu le malheur de vivre il y a quelques jours, de retour d'un événement cyber. Des centaines de personnes étaient dans le même train que le nôtre, et d'autres ont été impactées. Et maintenant, qui rembourse ce voyage interminable ? C'est la question que se posent les voyageurs du TER ZOU ! immobilisé au Dramont le 9 octobre, sur la ligne Marseille-Nice, dont le premier volet de notre enquête retraçait la soirée. Pour y répondre, Clubic a décortiqué les conditions de vente du réseau ZOU !, le contrat régional et le règlement européen, avec la Région Sud, Transdev et SNCF Voyageurs. À qui réclamer son dû, que peut-on espérer, où se cachent les pièges : voici ce que nous avons appris, qui servira peut-être à d'autres.

Sur un TER, ne comptez pas sur l'opérateur pour venir vers vous après une panne. Non, c'est au voyageur de faire la démarche. Nous en avons fait l'expérience, puisque plus d'une semaine après la soirée du 9 octobre, aucun e-mail ni SMS…

articles.title: Fausses cagnottes : attention aux arnaques qui profitent des pillages du 17 octobre
articles.summary:
Les pillages survenus ce week-end à travers la France ont laissé un certain nombre de commerçants complètement dévastés. Marchandises volées, investissements partis en fumée, vitrines cassées, agressions physiques : les conséquences sont lourdes pour les commerçants touchés, qui doivent désormais faire face aux dégâts, aussi bien matériels que psychologiques. Face à cette situation, les cagnottes de soutien se sont multipliées. Certaines ont été mises en place par les commerçants eux-mêmes, tandis que d’autres sont mises en ligne à l’initiative de personnes désirant aider. Malheureusement, certains lancent aussi de fausses cagnottes, autrement dit, des arnaques.
Des escrocs profitent de la détresse des commerçants
Un gérant d’un magasin Micromania situé à Nice a été victime de pilleurs. Il a été agressé physiquement, tandis que son magasin a été pillé et ses vitrines cassées. Face aux images de l’agression et du pillage, mais aussi du courage dont l’homme a fait preuve, plusieurs personnes ont lancé des cagnottes afin de lui venir en aide. Cependant, le gérant a alerté sur la prolifération de fausses cagnottes en ligne.
Il explique dans une story Instagram : « Mon équipe et moi, on est très touchés par le soutien, merci pour ce que vous faites. articles.title: Intel Readies XMX-Accelerated XeSS Support for Valve's Proton Compatibility Layer
articles.summary:
Monday, October 19th 2026
Intel Readies XMX-Accelerated XeSS Support for Valve's Proton Compatibility Layer
Intel is preparing to add support for XeSS, accelerated by XMX cores in its graphics cards, to Valve's Proton compatibility layer. This is great news because the Valve Proton layer currently uses a slower version of the upscaler that is not very efficient. The XMX cores would significantly accelerate upscaling and bring substantial performance improvements. Intel is promoting XeSS and its latest version 3.0, which features multi-frame generation (MFG). This version integrates up to three generated frames between two rendered frames, resulting in up to a fourfold increase in frame rate using MFG, similar to NVIDIA's DLSS MFG technology. Intel is joining the trend of AI-generated frame insertion, which seems to be gradually expanding.
Looking at the latest "Panther Lake" SoC with Xe3 cores, each Xe3 core includes eight vector engines, eight matrix engines (XMX), and a dedicated ray tracing unit. These execution units now operate with higher utilization thanks to refined thread dispatch and load balancing. The vector and matrix engines double peak FP16 and INT8 throughput compared to Xe2, benefiting both traditional rendering and AI-assisted tasks such as denoising, upscaling, and frame generation. Hence, supporting XMX-accelerated XeSS will finally give Intel Xe gamers on Linux a much-needed performance bump.

articles.title: “No estamos prestando atención a los riesgos y ni a sus daños”, Bill Gates sobre el avance global de la IA
articles.summary:
Bill Gates advirtió en una entrevista en el Vaticano que los riesgos de la inteligencia artificial (IA) requieren una respuesta pública que el sector tecnológico no puede resolver por sí solo.
El fundador de Microsoft sostuvo que gobiernos y actores neutrales deben intervenir en un escenario marcado por el desarrollo acelerado de sistemas capaces de igualar o superar algunas capacidades cognitivas humanas.
“Creo que no estamos prestando atención a los riesgos y que no estamos haciendo lo suficiente para minimizar los daños”, afirmó. El empresario alertó sobre la posibilidad de que las herramientas más avanzadas queden concentradas en quienes puedan pagar por ellas.
A la vez, dijo que tampoco se aprovechan de forma suficiente las oportunidades de la inteligencia artificial para reducir desigualdades en salud, educación y agricultura.
Cuáles son los riesgos del avance de la IA, según Bill Gates
Gates alertó que la inteligencia artificial puede ampliar la capacidad de daño de los ciberdelincuentes con pocos recursos, porque la tecnología puede facilitar la sofisticación de fraudes, deepfakes, desinformación y ciberataques.
Ante los riesgos, el empresario afirmó: “El sector no puede autorregularse, debe estar guiado por actores neutrales, en primer lugar, los gobiernos”. Este laboratorio estadounidense es uno de los más importantes de la industria de la IA, y, como os explicamos ayer, ha concretado su propuesta asegurando que va a destinar el 5% de sus acciones al Fondo de Beneficio Público, si lo aprueban sus accionistas.

Si observamos el ritmo al que ha evolucionado la IA durante los últimos seis meses, la previsión de cinco años de Amodei resulta incluso demasiado conservadora. Après les manifestations du 17 octobre, l'ancien Premier ministre et candidat à la présidentielle Gabriel Attal a proposé sur RTL de "bloquer temporairement et de manière ciblée" certaines plateformes. Mais c'est oublier la jurisprudence du Conseil d'État et le règlement européen sur les services numériques.
Le candidat de Renaissance à la présidentielle reproche aux réseaux sociaux de rassembler les casseurs et d'entretenir un effet de meute. Rappelons qu'il avait déjà fait couper TikTok en Nouvelle-Calédonie quand il était Premier ministre.
Le Conseil d'État a fait jurisprudence
Sur RTL, Gabriel Attal parle d’un blocage limité aux territoires sur lesquels se déroulent des émeutes. Selon lui, des lycéens qui ne participaient pas aux saccages se laissent entraîner par ceux qui donnent l’impression d’agir en toute impunité.
Et ce n'est pas la première fois que l'idée lui traverses la tête. Souvenez-vous, en mai 2024, nous rapportions que TikTok restait bloqué en Nouvelle-Calédonie malgré les référés-libertés déposés par plusieurs associations, dont La Quadrature du Net. Le gouvernement s’appuyait sur un cadre de circonstances exceptionnelles, laquelle permet à l’exécutif de s’écarter du droit commun en cas de crise, plutôt que sur l’état d’urgence.
Mais le 1er avril 2025, le Conseil d’État a annulé la décision du 14 mai 2024. Le réseau avait été coupé du 15 au 29 mai. Le juge a pourtant reconnu que les émeutes justifiaient une interruption, et que TikTok avait servi à diffuser…

Xodus Nexus Launcher Brings Xbox Game Pass to SteamOS and Linux with Easy Management and Installs
We previously covered Xodus, a new open-source project that aimed to bring Xbox Game Pass and Xbox on PC games to Linux via reverse-engineered runtimes and Valve's Proton compatibility layer. Since then, the project has been forked and Xodus Nexus has spun off in the hopes to achieve the same goal but with the added benefit of a sleek UI on top of a modified Xodus runtime. 
As detailed on the project's GitHub, Xodus Nexus launcher runs a patched Nexus runtime and backend and allows users to browser the Xbox store, and install and run games in your library—both purchased and available from Game Pass. The launcher also supports Xbox cloud saves and sign-in for supported games. This is in contrast to Xodus, which relies on a command line interface for game installation and management.Xodus Nexus features also include:
- Add-on management
- Download and install queue
- VC++ and prerequisite management
- DualSense controller compatibility mode
- Built-in "add to Steam" functionality with automatic artwork and shortcuts
- Experimental gamepad navigation for standard controller maps.

articles.title: Mods can almost double DLSS 5 performance through Foveation, reducing resolution at the edges of frames — technique makes DLSS 5 possible on high-resolution ultrawide monitors
articles.summary:
Mods can almost double DLSS 5 performance through Foveation, reducing resolution at the edges of frames — technique makes DLSS 5 possible on high-resolution ultrawide monitors
This might actually make DLSS 5 more accessible.
Popular graphics post-processing injector software ReShade, commonly used to mod DLSS 5 into unsupported games, now has a foveated imaging add-on, including another standalone project that doesn't need precursor software, allowing DLSS 5 to affect only what's in view, reducing GPU load and increasing FPS.
Foveated imaging is nothing new; it's a technique that's been used in VR to increase performance. It works by only rendering what's in view, often increasing the resolution in the center and reducing it at the edges. Our eyes work in a similar way, with the clearest image in a small area in the center of your vision, blurring on the edges. With foveated rendering, you barely notice the lower-resolution edges as the peripheral vision is less concerned with fine details.
Instead of varying the resolution of the image, however, it varies the level of detail in DLSS 5 Neural Rendering. DLSS NR loads a whole AI model into your GPU and renders images in real time, making it a resource-intensive task; but the task is minimized greatly when most of the detail is only asked for in the middle of the image. articles.summary:
La descarga de XUPER TV mediante archivos APK externos implica riesgos que exceden la resolución de películas, series o transmisiones en vivo. La aplicación no se distribuye en Google Play Store, así que la instalación depende de páginas de terceros, sin garantías sobre el origen, la integridad o las modificaciones realizadas al archivo.
Ese circuito puede derivar en publicidad invasiva, ralentización del celular, pedidos de permisos que no corresponden con una plataforma streaming y la descarga de programas adicionales.
El Instituto Nacional de Ciberseguridad de España (Incibe) advierte que las aplicaciones maliciosas pueden robar información, bloquear archivos, registrar pulsaciones y acceder a mensajes de texto con códigos de verificación.
Por qué una APK puede traer publicidad invasiva
Una APK es el archivo de instalación de las aplicaciones de Android. El problema aparece cuando se descarga desde sitios no oficiales: el usuario no puede comprobar si se trata de la versión original, una copia modificada o un instalador que incorpora componentes adicionales.
En el caso de XUPER TV, la falta de una distribución verificable deja esa comprobación en manos de quien descarga el archivo. Una de las consecuencias habituales es la aparición de anuncios fuera de la aplicación, redirecciones a sitios web y ventanas emergentes.

Hasta que se conozcan los detalles de la nueva normativa española, Google ha suspendido su apuesta por un gran campus tecnológico en España, según adelantaba El Mundo.
El nodo Sol en pausa. De acuerdo a lo publicado por El Mundo, Google habría pausado sus proyectos de ampliación de su capacidad de cómputo en España y su correspondiente inversión de miles de millones de dólares. Google ya contaba con un centro de datos en Madrid con servidores alojados en centros de terceros, pero el proyecto más afectado es el que contemplaba la construcción de la estación para el cable submarino Sol que unirá Santander con Florida en una parcela de casi 6.000 m2 en Cantabria. articles.title: Microsoft targets the 'agentic insider' with new controls for rogue AI agents - SiliconANGLE
articles.summary:
Microsoft targets the ‘agentic insider’ with new controls for rogue AI agents
Microsoft Corp. today introduced security controls for rogue artificial intelligence agents that cut back what an agent may do as its assessed risk climbs.
The release takes on what Hayete Gallot, executive vice president of Microsoft Security, called the “agentic insider” in a blog post. Enterprise agents are often overprivileged, and their numbers are growing fast. Gallot argued that frontier models cannot be fully trusted because they are built to chase results. Some will reach a goal in ways nobody intended, she wrote, including by colluding with other agents.
Microsoft Chairman and Chief Executive Satya Nadella laid out the thinking behind the controls in an Oct. 10 essay that urged companies to treat models as insider risks, with safeguards kept outside the model itself. The most trustworthy system, he wrote, will be “the one that enables us to trust the model the least.”
The controls start with finding agents. Microsoft’s discovery tools can now spot 60 types of local agents on employee machines after 35 were added. The list includes Anthropic PBC’s Claude Code and OpenAI Group PBC’s Codex, as well as GitHub Copilot from Microsoft’s own GitHub unit. The company is also extending Microsoft Entra Agent ID to give those agents, and unknown ones its sensors find, identities of their own.

articles.title: Modern software is built on the backs of low-paid maintainers, opening the door to potential threats — report details critically underfunded projects that remain understaffed or unfunded
articles.summary:
Nearly half of critical open-source software relies on just one or two low-paid maintainers, opening the door to potential threats — report details critically underfunded projects that remain understaffed or unfunded
Welp, time to bring out that xkcd comic out again.
Modern computing systems and devices typically require pieces of crucial open-source software, typically maintained by unpaid or low-paid volunteers. Recently, a report collated a list of critical open-source projects, noting which of them are chronically underfunded and/or understaffed. The information is sobering: 11 out of 23 of the listed projects currently only have one or two maintainers, and funding is generally scarce and sometimes nonexistent.
The Data Drop's report on open-source maintainers identifies that having only one or two sets of eyes on critical pieces of software means that sooner or later something breaks — and it tends to do so in spectacular fashion, given its ubiquity. So, what happens when these projects, which are widely used across software, go underfunded or understaffed?
Lessons from the past
In 2014, the same year as Heartbleed, Shellshock made waves: a vulnerability in the Bash shell that's present in Linux, macOS, and Unix-type systems. The problem was traced back to a line of code present since 1989, displaying how even software that's thought to have all the bugs hammered out of it can still fall prey to attacks. articles.title: Cómo usar Windows RE: el salvavidas oculto de Microsoft cuando cuando Windows deja de funcionar en el PC
articles.summary:
Windows no siempre arranca como debería, y cuando eso ocurre no hace falta recurrir a un técnico ni reinstalar el sistema desde cero. Existe una herramienta integrada que puede resolver buena parte de esos problemas sin perder archivos ni configuraciones.
Se trata de Windows RE, abreviatura de Windows Recovery Environment o entorno de recuperación de Windows. Viene preinstalado de forma predeterminada en Windows 10 y Windows 11, en todas sus ediciones de escritorio, así como en Windows Server 2016 y versiones posteriores.
Windows RE es el entorno de recuperación que permite reparar las causas más comunes de los sistemas operativos que no logran arrancar, sin necesidad de reinstalar Windows desde cero ni perder archivos personales. Funciona como un sistema operativo complementario que carga solo lo necesario para diagnosticar y corregir fallos.
La herramienta se basa en el Entorno de preinstalación de Windows, conocido como Windows PE, y puede personalizarse con controladores adicionales, idiomas extra y componentes opcionales. No debe confundirse con el modo seguro de Windows, aunque ambos cumplen funciones similares de diagnóstico.
Cuándo conviene usar Windows RE
Conviene acceder a Windows RE ante problemas críticos que impiden usar el escritorio con normalidad. El caso más habitual es un equipo atrapado en un bucle de reinicios o que muestra una pantalla negra o azul antes de llegar al inicio de sesión.

Monday, October 19th 2026
DLSS Swapper Adds Bulk Swap for DLSS, FSR, and XeSS Across Entire Game Libraries
DLSS Swapper finally supports bulk DLL swapping, with version 1.2.7.0 landing on GitHub on October 18. Brad Moore's open-source tool lets PC gamers upgrade or downgrade the DLSS, FSR, and XeSS files in their installed games without waiting for a developer patch, but until now, that meant going through every game one at a time. Videocardz points out that the new Bulk Swap button in the games page toolbar lets users tick multiple games, then pick a version for each DLL type, plus presets for DLSS Super Resolution, Frame Generation, and Ray Reconstruction. Every row defaults to "Don't change," so nothing gets touched unless it's chosen. Apparently, users had been asking for this on GitHub for quite a while, with some saying they had well over 50 DLSS games to update by hand.
Bulk restoration of the original DLLs made it in too. Moore had pointed out in that same thread that users would need an easy way back if a new DLSS build turned out to be a regression across, say, 160 games. Of course, a swapped DLL can still stop a game from launching, and titles with anti-cheat might flag modified files, so online games are probably best left alone. Ce lundi 19 octobre, une mesure du secrétaire à la Sécurité intérieure américaine Markwayne Mullin, a été publiée. Elle interdit aux agences civiles du pays d’acheter et d’utiliser les produits de DeepSeek. Une mesure qui vise directement l’État chinois, accusé de plusieurs méfaits via cette intelligence artificielle.
Les États-Unis ne veulent plus de DeepSeek chez eux
C’est le Département de la Sécurité intérieure (DHS) qui a pris cette mesure au titre du Federal Acquisition Supply Chain Security Act de 2018. Une loi qui permet d’exclure les fournisseurs jugés risqués de la chaîne d’approvisionnement fédérale, ce qui concerne aussi les applications et systèmes informatiques. L’ordre a donc été signé par le secrétaire de ce département, Markwayne Mullin : il était initialement daté du 24 juillet, avant sa publication publique ce 19 octobre au Federal Register, rapporte la BBC. Une étape de plus après que l’Agence d’information de la défense américaine (DISA) avait bloqué DeepSeek sur les réseaux du Pentagone en janvier 2025, comme le précise CyberScoop. En mai 2025, c’est Microsoft qui avait interdit à ses employés d’utiliser cette IA.
Cette mesure impose deux obligations aux agences civiles : supprimer tous les usages de DeepSeek en vigueur et renoncer à l’installer à nouveau. Elle couvre directement la version de DeepSeek distribuée par Hangzhou DeepSeek Artrificial Intelligence Co., l’entreprise chinoise qui l’édite, mais pas que. articles.title: Con instrucciones en chino, un hacker vulneró sitios de más de 100 empresas: usó agentes de IA casi sin supervisión humana
articles.summary:
Un hacker que habla chino logró vulnerar los sitios web de más de cien empresas, entre ellas la fabricante de maquinaria agrícola Deere, la compañía de electrodomésticos SharkNinja y el fabricante de motores Cummins, usando casi exclusivamente agentes de inteligencia artificial que operaron sin supervisión humana.
El hallazgo surge de un informe de Snorre Fagerland, investigador principal de amenazas de la empresa de ciberseguridad NorForge, entregado a la agencia Reuters antes de su publicación. Fagerland descubrió la campaña mientras rastreaba en internet instancias mal configuradas y expuestas de Cairn, una plataforma de código abierto que describe a sí misma como un “motor de resolución de problemas de propósito general”.

Un ataque de apenas 50 dólares por intrusión

Android a discrètement commencé à relier votre numéro de téléphone à tous les comptes Google connectés à votre smartphone. Mais il est encore possible de l'en empêcher.
Le numéro de téléphone est devenu une information clé pour Google. La firme, que Donald Trump dit avoir à sa botte, a, en mai dernier, ramené à 5 Go le stockage gratuit pour les nouveaux comptes qui refusaient de fournir le numéro de leur smartphone. Un nouveau réglage de Google Play Services pourrait bien faire grincer des dents les utilisateurs. On vous explique.

C’est un utilisateur de Reddit qui a tiré la sonnette d’alarme : « Les services Google Play se « vérifient eux-mêmes » et lient votre numéro de téléphone à TOUS les comptes connectés sans autorisation explicite. Juste un petit avertissement pour quiconque valorise la confidentialité de base sur Android. ». Dans les faits, cela voudrait dire qu’Android relierait votre compte perso, votre compte pro et vos adresses secondaires à un seul et même numéro sans vous demander votre avis.
Les contenus ne se mélangent pas pour autant, mais cela suffit à prouver que tous ces profils ont le même propriétaire. Dream Labs, a startup trying to make robots more intelligent and capable of performing many different tasks, has raised $90 million in seed funding to coincide with the launch of a public application programming interface that provides access to its universal robot foundation model.

Dream Labs is taking aim at the lack of intelligence in today’s robots, which might be fairly numerous in many environments but are also fairly limited. The startup believes there are more than 5 million industrial robots working inside factories and warehouses globally. These robots surely do perform useful work, otherwise their owners wouldn’t have invested in them, but Dream Labs co-founder and Chief Executive Joel Jang believes they should be able to do so much more.

articles.title: Uncharted Trilogy Reaches PC Through Unofficial Ports
articles.summary:
Monday, October 19th 2026
Uncharted Trilogy Reaches PC Through Unofficial Ports
The first three Uncharted games have made their way to PC, though Sony had nothing to do with it. Developer SuperMedo, who is also behind an unofficial Bloodborne port, has released Uncharted for Windows. It's an unofficial port of the PS4's Uncharted: The Nathan Drake Collection, covering Drake's Fortune, Among Thieves, and Drake's Deception. Its first public build went up on GitHub on October 15. Sony did bring Uncharted 4 and The Lost Legacy to PC back in 2022, but the original trilogy never followed. The port runs the PS4 version's own x86-64 game code directly on the PC and replaces the console's system functions. It then translates the graphics work to Vulkan through a renderer based on the shadPS4 emulator. Players need their own decrypted dump of the collection, since no game files are included.
All three games get 60 and 120 FPS modes, with anything higher marked as experimental. Anti-aliasing options include TAA, FSR 3.1, FSR 4, and DLAA. Frame generation comes as FSR 3 on any GPU, or as DLSS Frame Generation at 2x on RTX 40 cards and up to 4x on RTX 50. It's not all smooth sailing, of course. Per the GitHub page, one user finished Drake's Fortune on an RTX 4060 laptop at 1080p with DLAA, mostly seeing 100 to 120 FPS, though a crash in chapter 11 corrupted their save. A separate project from BilalReloaded takes a similar approach, with render resolutions from 720p up to 4K. With Sony rep…

Un pirate chinois est parvenu à infiltrer les sites de plus de 100 entreprises d’envergure. articles.title: Robar con un celular y un código QR nunca fue tan fácil: ojo a la modalidad que roba datos y fotos
articles.summary:
Escanear un código QR puede conducir a una estafa si el enlace redirige a una página falsa creada para robar dinero, datos personales o credenciales de acceso. Estos códigos aparecen en parquímetros, restaurantes, carteles, facturas y anuncios, por lo que se han convertido en un recurso habitual para realizar pagos, consultar información o abrir sitios web desde el teléfono.
El riesgo surge cuando un delincuente sustituye un código legítimo por otro diseñado para engañar. La Comisión Federal de Consumidores de Estados Unidos advierte sobre casos en los que estafadores cubrieron los códigos QR de parquímetros con versiones falsas. Al escanearlas, la víctima puede terminar en una web fraudulenta y entregar información bancaria o personal. La revisión del enlace antes de abrirlo es la primera medida de protección.
Los peligros de escanear códigos QR
Pagar un estacionamiento mediante un código QR parece una opción rápida. El usuario escanea la imagen, abre una página de pago e introduce sus datos. Sin embargo, este procedimiento puede facilitar una estafa si alguien colocó un adhesivo falso encima del código original.
El código malicioso puede llevar a un sitio que imita la apariencia de una plataforma de pagos. Allí, el delincuente puede solicitar el número de tarjeta, datos personales, contraseñas o información de contacto. También puede intentar instalar programas maliciosos en el dispositivo.

Exclusive: Kantata’s Expertise Insights answers services firms’ business questions in plain English
Professional services automation software company Kantata Inc. today added generative business intelligence to its Expertise Engine platform with the launch of Expertise Insights.
Users ask about the business in plain English, as in where margin pressure is showing up, and the software answers with an interactive chart, a calculation or an executive summary.
Kantata’s pitch rests on how long it takes services firms to get answers out of their own data. The company says a request often has to go through a business intelligence analyst or a services engagement, and the wait can run to a week.
Sarah Edwards, Kantata’s chief product and strategy officer, said the value of an insight in professional services “depends on how quickly you can act on it.” Reports often show up after the moment has passed, she said.
Expertise Insights runs on Amazon Web Services Inc.’s Amazon Quick. On top of it Kantata has added a semantic layer that translates database field names into the vocabulary staff at a particular firm use every day. Firm-specific terms are covered, down to distinctions such as “chargeable utilization” versus “billable utilization.”

Monday, October 19th 2026
Amazon Ships Ryzen 9 9950X3D2 With an Intel CPU Hiding Underneath
A Reddit user in the r/watercooling subreddit bought an AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D2 Dual Edition from Amazon and noticed that something was off. This was his second 9950X3D2 chip, and both chips were sold and shipped by Amazon and arrived in sealed retail boxes, with identical markings on the heat spreader. Flip them over, however, and the newer one looks nothing like the first. It has a large empty area in the middle packed with tiny capacitors, while a genuine AM5 Ryzen chip has gold contact pads covering nearly its entire underside. The user initially assumed AMD had quietly revised the design. Commenters thought otherwise, and the top reply suggests that someone delidded a real 9950X3D2, attached its heat spreader to an old Intel processor, and sent the fake back to Amazon for a refund. That chip has now ended up in our Redditor's hands.
In this case, the layout is a big giveaway, since Intel desktop chips place many of their capacitors on the underside of the substrate, whereas AMD keeps them on top to leave room for contacts. The lettering on the fake also looks smudged, possibly from the delid or a reprint. It's still unclear which Intel CPU sits underneath, and there's no word from Amazon so far on the matter. articles.summary:
An intruder reached a legacy system at OpenCode on the night of October 16 and may have exposed the third-party AI provider keys that users had saved in OpenCode Console, the company said.
Console is OpenCode's optional hosted service: a workspace saves its own OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google key there, and Console uses that key to call the provider so team members can use the models without ever seeing the key.
The affected group is 1.4% of Console users, all of whom have an outside provider linked, and OpenCode has told them via email to revoke those keys with each provider and replace them.
The email went out on the morning of October 17 under the subject line "Action Required: Potential provider key breach." Anyone who did not get one was not affected, OpenCode said in a post on X later that day.
The keys at risk are the ones pasted into Console. The OpenCode command-line and desktop apps keep provider keys added on the machine in a SQLite database there. The breach involves "the OpenCode Console, not OpenCode itself," co-founder Dax Raad wrote in a reply on X, and those keys "never come to us."
A provider key is a bearer credential: whoever holds a copy can run billable requests against the owner's account until the provider revokes it. Deleting the key from Console does not revoke it, and a Console budget cannot cap that use either, because Console only sees requests that pass through its own gateway.

articles.title: Unpatched Broadcom Wi-Fi Flaw Lets Attackers in Range Run Code as Root on Routers
articles.summary:
A flaw in Broadcom's Wi-Fi setup software lets an attacker within radio range run code as root on Broadcom-based routers, without the network password or any pairing step, security researcher Quentin Kaiser disclosed on October 16.
He showed the attack working against home gateways supplied by three Belgian internet providers, in one case reading the Wi-Fi password off the device and in another opening a remote shell over the air. No CVE has been assigned to the flaw, and no fix has been deployed to the affected routers, Kaiser says.
The flaw is in Broadcom's version of Wi-Fi Protected Setup (WPS), the feature that lets a device join a Wi-Fi network without the password being typed in. Broadcom's code mishandles the reassembly of fragmented WPS setup messages, so an attacker in range can send crafted messages that corrupt the router's memory. From there, Kaiser built two things: a way to read memory back off the device, and a way to run his own code on it.
Against an Orange Belgium gateway, the Askey TCG3000 read the Wi-Fi password (the PSK) from the router's stored settings, sent it back over the air, and then joined the network with it.
Against a Proximus gateway, the Sagemcom-built BBOX3V+, the exploit opened a reverse shell, a remote command line, carried over Wi-Fi frames, so no outside server was needed.

Rising temperatures are testing the limits of our wireless infrastructure
Five degrees might not sound like much when you look at the weather forecast. But for the networks our everyday lives depend on, it can mean the difference between equipment running reliably and being pushed past the limits it was built for.
That matters more every year as extreme heat becomes more common. Heatwaves, wildfires, severe storms, and prolonged periods of high temperatures are putting IT infrastructure under pressure in places that were never designed for these conditions.
At the same time, the hardware inside our networks is becoming more powerful and densely packed, making it even harder to keep cool.
Director of Wireless Product Management at Extreme Networks.
Traditionally, outdoor wireless equipment has been designed to operate at temperatures of up to 60°C, taking into account both the heat outside the equipment and the heat generated by the hardware itself. But some vendors are now lowering that ceiling to around 55°C.
As temperatures rise and access points generate more heat of their own, that five-degree difference could be critical.
Our networks are getting hotter

articles.title: From Email-to-Case to the Boardroom: How Inherited Agents Break Governance Built for Software
articles.summary:
In Salesforce Agentforce, the recommended way to make an agent respond to events is a Flow: a record is created or a case is updated, and the Flow passes data into the agent's prompt. Separately, Email-to-Case and Web-to-Case turn inbound customer messages into case records; it is how airlines and hotels run support intake. Both are standard, documented, as-designed features. Chained together, they produce this path:
public internet → email → case record → agent prompt → agent action → case comment → outbound reply
An unauthenticated outsider now has a route into an internal agent's instructions, and the agent's reply leaves through the same door. Nothing was misconfigured. The finding, documented by researchers in August 2026, is a clean example of how agents that arrive inside existing platforms fail: through the application around them, not the model inside them.
The risk is in the application, and the application is the thing nobody re-reviewed
Which intake features are enabled, which triggers fire, which objects are exposed to guest users, which automation passes untrusted data where, and which model version the agent is quietly calling underneath: these are the variables that decide whether the Agentforce chain is a support-queue nuisance or a data exposure. A vendor risk review performed once at procurement sees none of them, because the agent did not exist at procurement. AI is breaking the link between effort, cost and value
You don't need to understand the mechanics of AI tools to understand what's happening to traditional technology pricing. AI is breaking the link between effort, cost and value that technology services have relied on for decades.
Imagine two managed service providers responding to the same production incident. One assigns an engineer who spends five hours tracing logs, checking dependencies and isolating the root cause.
The other uses AI-enabled observability to identify the issue in minutes, trigger the appropriate remediation and restore service before users notice. The second provider used fewer hours but delivered more value. Should they be paid less?
Senior Vice-President, Global Business Engineering, CGI.
Enterprise technology services are running into the same pricing challenge, but on a larger scale. The old pricing model equated more hours with higher cost and, in theory, greater value. In our own client engagements, we're seeing auto-generated tickets fall by as much as 70%, roughly one in five operational events resolved autonomously, and up to 45% fewer major outages where predictive models are in place.

articles.title: When the model takes away the moat

When the model takes away the moat
The need to democratize AI model ownership
There has been an explosion of AI-powered products released over the past four years, with most built on top of leading foundation models. Startups, enterprise software vendors, and even large incumbents route their core intelligence through APIs from the leading AI labs, and a growing but still narrow set of open-weight alternatives.
CEO and co-founder of Boltzbit.
This arrangement has most certainly enabled a genuine burst of AI products, but it has also created a structural fragility which can be remedied through the democratization of model creation and training.
Defining a wrapper
In its simplest form, an AI wrapper is a product whose core function is an interface sitting on top of a third-party foundation model's API, with little to no proprietary technology beneath that layer.
That approach can have a short lifespan and Jasper can illustrate that. Once the standout of the AI writing boom with a $1.5 billion peak valuation, Jasper saw its core market vaporized when ChatGPT introduced free, native writing features. Its revenue fell from approximately $120 million in 2023 to approximately $55 million in 2024. Jasper did survive, by redirecting its efforts toward enterprise workflows and brand-specific training.

Après les pillages du 17 octobre, certains, comme Bruno Retailleau, réclame l’état d’urgence et le gouvernement le garde en réserve. Ce régime d’exception issu d’une loi de 1955 permettrait surtout des mesures individuelles, mais pas de couper librement les réseaux sociaux.
Depuis les pillages qui ont suivi les manifestations du 17 octobre, l'état d'urgence s'est invité dans de nombreuses conversations, des plateaux télé aux fils d'actualité, aussi bien c'est ceux qui réclament son instauration que ceux qui le vilipendent. Le gouvernement de Sébastien Lecornu a préféré miser lundi soir des couvre-feux localisés à Paris, Lyon ou Lille, tout en gardant le régime d'exception sous le coude « si c'est nécessaire ». Entre la loi de 1955, la jurisprudence du Conseil d’État sur TikTok et le règlement européen DSA sur le services numériques, les marges de manœuvre de l’exécutif sont pourtant plus étroites qu’il n’y paraît.
L'état d’urgence, un pouvoir d’exception, pas un chèque en blanc
Cette fameuse loi de 1955, justement, mérite qu'on s'y arrête. Votée le 3 avril 1955, en pleine guerre d'Algérie, elle a donné naissance à un régime d'exception que la Constitution ne mentionne même pas, et qui ne peut être déclenché qu'en cas de péril imminent lié à des atteintes graves à l'ordre public. Le président le décrète en conseil des ministres, pour douze jours maximum. Au-delà, seul le Parlement peut le prolonger par une loi, qui devient caduque quinze jours après une démission du gouverneme…

Qué riesgos hay al componer una canción con IA
Componer una melodía, escribir una letra con apoyo de un sistema generativo o producir una base instrumental mediante IA no configura, de forma automática, un delito.

Cuáles son los cambios en los nombres de Gemini

Los Gems funcionaban como bots personalizados independientes: cada uno se seleccionaba desde una barra lateral y abría una conversación separada. Esa lógica desaparece con la llegada de las Skills, un sistema que incorpora las instrucciones personalizadas directamente al chat principal de Gemini.

A copy of 3.0.123 obtained before 20:02 UTC on October 15 is outside it.

Faire tourner une IA locale exige généralement un ordinateur doté de suffisamment de mémoire et de puissance de calcul. Pourtant, des développeurs ont trouvé un moyen d'exploiter un matériel déjà présent dans des millions de foyers : la PlayStation 5.
Tout commence avec PS5LM, un projet de Mert Cobanov qui adapte le moteur llama.cpp à la console de Sony. En quelques jours, un dérivé baptisé PS5LM Plus, développé par abhi245y, est allé beaucoup plus loin en permettant aux modèles d'utiliser directement le GPU AMD de la machine.
Du processeur au GPU, les performances changent d'échelle
La première approche utilisait uniquement le processeur de la PS5, avec environ 6 Gio de mémoire accessibles au programme. Sur un modèle volumineux, Qwen 3.8 27B, le résultat était extrêmement lent : environ un token généré par minute, les données devant être lues depuis le stockage.

Organizations can be under huge pressure to make changes to their IT estates. In particular, there are two drivers of this change.
Firstly, there’s the pressure to innovate. The rapid advancement of technology and AI coupled with shifting business priorities can put organizations under pressure to adopt the latest tools, with vendor messaging advocating for the speed of adoption. Simultaneously, ongoing inflation and slower economic growth can mean there is a need to find more cost-effective solutions.
Technical Manager at Cloudhouse.
Secondly, there’s the change that is forced. Operating systems might be reaching their end of life and need upgrading, or there are outages and cyber threats to defend against. There have also been several recent examples of software vendor prices rising significantly due to ownership changes, like with VMware, and companies therefore needing to find new solutions for their budget and reduce vendor dependency.
However, in dealing with these pressures, the trap companies can fall into is trying to deliver all of this change at once and within a small timeframe. Yet in doing so, this change becomes harder to manage and the risk of outages and system failures increases. So, how can they deliver any change that is needed safely?

articles.summary:
An attacker used a contributor's GitHub account to replace the download archives on five existing releases of OVHcloud's command-line tool on Monday, October 19. The account had been hijacked, and the new files were a build designed to steal secrets stored on the disk of any machine that runs it, the cloud provider says.
They were live on GitHub for up to 94 minutes, from 12:47 to 14:21 UTC, and reached only people who installed or updated the OVHcloud CLI during that window, via a path that checks for no hash, on macOS, Linux x86_64 or arm64, or Windows x86_64.
OVHcloud deleted the swapped archives and published a clean v0.16.0 that evening as an immutable release, whose files GitHub will not let anyone change. The source code, the release tag, and the company's build pipeline were not touched: the bad build was a plain go build of a later commit, uploaded straight onto releases published between April and September.
Who Was Exposed
On v0.15.0, the attacker replaced six files: the macOS x86_64 and arm64 archives, the Linux x86_64 and arm64 archives, the Windows x86_64 archive, and the checksums.txt file, so the published hashes matched the new binaries. The same six files are now gone from v0.11.0 to v0.14.0 as well. The Linux i386, Windows i386, Windows arm64, and WebAssembly builds were left alone on every release.

Programs built on the new release will refuse connections to sites and services whose certificates were issued under those keys. The Go team says the keys belong to one certificate authority it has not named, and that it is blocking them because of "specific security concerns around their operation."
It handled the fix on its URGENT track, the one reserved for its most serious issues, and recommends upgrading immediately.
Two days earlier, on October 17, Mozilla added six intermediate certificates issued by eMudhra's emSign Root TLS CA - G3 to OneCRL, the list Firefox uses to block certificates. The Mozilla bug behind those entries is closed to the public, and neither Mozilla nor Go has said what prompted its action. Whether Chrome, Apple, or Microsoft have taken similar action is not established.
Go's change lists only the SHA-256 hashes of the eight keys. A commenter on the Go issue matched all eight to eMudhra intermediates by looking the hashes up in certificate records.

articles.title: HP OmniBook 3 : petit prix et jusqu’à 20 heures d’autonomie... grâce au Snapdragon C ?
articles.summary:
L’Omnibook 3 n’est pas une nouveauté à proprement parler chez HP, mais ce modèle se décline en cette fin d’année au travers d’une nouvelle configuration 16 pouces motorisée par un processeur encore peu répandu : le Snapdragon C. Si ses performances s’annoncent modestes, le prix et l’autonomie de l’engin, eux, pourraient bien faire mouche sur l’entrée de gamme.
Dans le sillage du MacBook Neo, toute une flopée de PC portables à 800 euros a été lancée par les constructeurs de modèles Windows. Ce n’est pas le cas du nouveau HP Omnibook 3 qui nous intéresse aujourd’hui.
Fort d’un format 16 pouces plus confortable, ce dernier tire parti d’un processeur Snapdragon C (C1-10-100), annoncé au printemps mais encore peu usité, pour s’installer sur l’entrée de gamme avec la promesse d’une autonomie vraiment généreuse.
Un PC « efficace et pas cher » ? Peut-être, mais attention quand même…
Pour contexte, le HP Omnibook 3 de 16 pouces existait déjà sur le marché depuis quelques mois, notamment au travers d’une configuration Snapdragon X (X1P-26-100) qui avait plutôt été saluée pour son rapport équipement / prix et son autonomie. articles.title: What Security Teams Can Do To Tame Wild Code
articles.summary:
A sales manager builds an AI-assisted workflow to route leads. It connects to customer records, summarizes inbound requests, and posts updates to a shared channel. The workflow saves time, reduces manual work, and soon becomes part of the team’s daily routine. Across the same organization, employees are building useful apps, agents, and automations faster than existing processes can support them.
If you work in security, that success introduces a new set of questions. Whose credentials does the workflow use? Which records can it access? Who can see its output? If it starts exposing information it shouldn’t, can you trace what happened and stop further access?
Wild code takes root when useful builds spread faster than the processes for owning, securing, and maintaining them. It isn’t simply another name for unapproved software. Employees are creating new capabilities, not just adopting existing products. A small experiment can become an operational dependency before security knows it exists.
The risk goes beyond vulnerabilities in generated code. Even code that works as intended can operate with too much access or expose data to the wrong audience:
- Excessive permissions. A workflow needs a small set of records but runs with credentials that can read or modify far more.
- Sensitive data exposure. An employee connects an agent to information it doesn’t need, or makes its output available too broadly. Sensitive information can also end up in model requests or logs.
- Unintended…

articles.title: Microsoft admits 'frontier models can't be trusted', unveils new security tools to treat AI agents as insider threats
articles.summary:
Microsoft admits 'frontier models can't be trusted', unveils new security tools to treat AI agents as insider threats
Say hi to your new Guardian Agent
- Microsoft unveils Guardian Agents to monitor, constrain, and manage risks posed by autonomous AI agents
- New controls dynamically adjust agent permissions, behavior, and access based on changing risk levels
- Company warns “agentic insiders” require continuous AI-driven oversight beyond traditional security controls
AI fans, your vocabulary is about to become two phrases richer: Agentic Insider, and Guardian Agent. These are the two phrases Microsoft used while announcing a swathe of new tools and features to help businesses secure their operations running AI agents.
A new Microsoft blog, published by Microsoft's Corporate VP for Identity and Network Access, Nadim Abdo, argues that agents, while not inherently malicious, can make mistakes or be manipulated and compromised.
Since they need to be granted relatively extensive permissions in order to be able to work properly, it creates the sort of risk that can prove disastrous if not properly handled.
Agentic Overwatch
Abdo also added that AI agents doing their master's bidding cannot be trusted with their own security.

articles.title: Orange vient d’éteindre la 2G presque partout en France : SFR et Bouygues Telecom vont très vite suivre
articles.summary:
L'opérateur Orange a éteint ce mardi son réseau 2G dans les 43 derniers départements de l’Hexagone. Une fin quasi totale pour la technologie, avant celle de SFR et Bouygues Telecom, programmée d’ici mi-décembre.
La fin de la 2G chez Orange est plus que jamais une réalité, puisque ce mardi 20 octobre 2026, l'opérateur historique a coupé son réseau 2G dans les 43 derniers départements de l'Hexagone où il émettait encore. L'entreprise peut se concentrer sur un réseau plus sûr, plus sobre d'un point de vue énergétique, en plus de récupérer au passage des fréquences pour la 4G et la 5G. À la fin du mois de juin, pourtant, 1,7 million d'appareils dépendaient encore uniquement de la 2G selon l'ARCEP, tandis que SFR et Bouygues Telecom préparent déjà leur propre coupure, qui ne va pas tarder. On vous explique.
Pourquoi Orange coupe la 2G sans regret
La dernière vague d'extinction du réseau 2G d'Orange est tombée ce mardi, et on peut dire qu'elle touche du monde. Paris, le Rhône, le Nord ou encore la Gironde figurent parmi les 43 départements concernés. Bayonne, Anglet et Biarritz avaient servi d'éclaireurs le 31 mars dernier, avant le reste du Sud-Ouest en mai et juin, Nice le 22 septembre puis 44 départements le 6 octobre. D'après le calendrier de l'opérateur, les zones blanches réglementaires, ces secteurs mal couverts où les opérateurs partagent leurs antennes, gardent la 2G jusqu'au 15 décembre au plus tard.

articles.title: Guía de Dragon Ball Super Beerus: cuántos episodios tendrá y dónde verlos completos
articles.summary:
Dragon Ball Super Beerus tendrá 19 episodios que se estrenan uno por semana. La serie llegó a Crunchyroll el 11 de octubre de 2026, tanto en Latinoamérica como en España, aunque las opciones de streaming cambian según la región.
En América Latina, el anime también está disponible en Disney+, HBO Max y Netflix, con estrenos escalonados. Disney+ comenzó el 14 de octubre, HBO Max el 16 y Netflix el 17.

En Latinoamérica, el calendario publicado fija los estrenos de Crunchyroll para los domingos, los de Disney+ para los miércoles, los de HBO Max para los viernes y los de Netflix para los sábados. articles.title: WhatsApp Hid Instructions in Help Pages Telling Its AI Chatbot Not to Recommend Privacy Regulators
articles.summary:
WhatsApp's help pages carried hidden instructions for its support chatbot that told it not to recommend a data protection authority or regulator to users who could no longer delete their accounts, even though WhatsApp's own privacy policy for Europe tells users they can complain to one.
The text sat in the pages' code, never shown on screen, until it was removed by October 18. Whether the chatbot ever followed the instructions is not known: Redact, the data-deletion software company that found the text, read the instructions, not the chatbot's answers.
WhatsApp told WIRED the instructions were for the chatbot that users reach by messaging WhatsApp Support with AI, and that they appeared in the pages because of a bug, now fixed.
A second block of hidden text on the page about reporting and blocking told the chatbot that once a user mentioned a lawyer, a lawsuit, or a court, it should not cite privacy laws such as the GDPR, even when the user raised them.
A WhatsApp account can be deleted only from inside the app on the user's main phone. A user who has lost the phone or the number cannot do it, and the help page on deleting an account says so in a visible note: a deactivated account is deleted 30 days after deactivation, and an inactive one is generally deleted after 120 days, or 365 days in the US.
Beneath that note, in text the page never displayed, sat instructions that repeated the waiting periods and added three orders, according to Redact's copy of the page from October …

Google modificará desde el 17 de noviembre la forma en que los usuarios de cuentas personales emplean Gemini, con un cambio que transformará Gems, Skills, Spark, Tarea y las Acciones programadas.
La reorganización integrará instrucciones personalizadas y automatizaciones dentro del chat principal, un ajuste que altera cómo se crean, combinan y ejecutan funciones de inteligencia artificial.

Las cuentas de trabajo y de centros educativos adoptarán el mismo modelo en 2027.
Los Gems se convierten en Skills
Hasta ahora, los Gems funcionaban como asistentes independientes. El usuario los seleccionaba en una barra lateral y cada elección abría una conversación separada. Desde el 17 de noviembre, Google iniciará la conversión automática de los Gems personales en Skills, un formato que traslada las instrucciones configuradas al hilo principal de Gemini.
Tras esa migración, la interfaz anterior desaparecerá para esas cuentas y ya no hará falta cambiar de ventana para recuperar una configuración concreta.

articles.title: Apple explica por qué Safari ya no dejará que las empresas rastreen a usuarios a través del email
articles.summary:
Apple amplió el bloqueo de Safari contra empresas que realizan rastreo de usuarios mediante direcciones de email, una medida que alcanza a iPhone, iPad, Mac y Vision Pro y que apunta a impedir la identificación de una misma persona en distintos sitios web para mostrarle anuncios personalizados.
La decisión afecta a LiveRamp, ID5, UID 2.0 de The Trade Desk, Permutive y Audigent, que estuvieron entre las primeras compañías sin soporte tras la actualización de software lanzada en septiembre de 2026.
Los ingenieros del navegador explicaron que Safari deja de comunicarse por completo con esos servicios una vez actualizado el dispositivo. El mecanismo bloqueado comienza cuando una persona ingresa su correo para iniciar sesión en un sitio o recibir un boletín.
Una empresa externa puede convertir esa dirección en un identificador que permite reconocer al usuario en múltiples páginas sin recurrir a cookies.
Apple sostuvo que el correo pasó a ocupar el lugar que antes tenían las cookies en la infraestructura de seguimiento. Safari ya había restringido el uso de esos archivos seis años antes, lo que llevó a parte de la industria publicitaria a buscar otros métodos para vincular la actividad de los usuarios.

Las compañías de tecnología publicitaria se incorporan de forma invisible a las páginas donde los usuarios escriben sus direcciones, según explicó Apple en su blog.

More map styles and details

While Google has added plenty of new features and refinements to its Google Messages app in recent months and years, it still lags behind competitors such as WhatsApp when it comes to certain facets of the app — like sharing your location with other people.
This is something that's essential for social meet-ups, keeping tabs on the kids, planning journey times, and more besides, and hidden code spotted by Android Authority suggests that location sharing in Google Messages is about to get a significant upgrade.
This is code that's present but not yet enabled in the latest beta version of Google Messages for Android, but the Android Authority team was able to get it working. It adds several map types and a map details option, when you choose to share your location.

articles.title: Des pirates détournent des NAS D-Link et des enregistreurs Ubiquiti pour gagner de l'argent avec votre connexion Internet
articles.summary:
Des cybercriminels exploitent des failles connues pour transformer des équipements connectés en relais Internet rémunérés. Une campagne qui menace aussi la réputation des adresses IP des victimes, susceptibles de servir à d'autres activités malveillantes.
Des pirates ont trouvé un moyen de rentabiliser leurs intrusions sans voler de données ni réclamer de rançon. Leur méthode consiste à détourner des équipements connectés à Internet pour y installer un logiciel de partage de bande passante et tenter d'en tirer des revenus. Une campagne de proxyjacking sur laquelle les chercheurs en cybersécurité de GreyNoise ont enquêté, révélant la compromission d'au moins 143 appareils dans 34 pays, dont des NAS et des systèmes de vidéosurveillance.

Découvrez Bitdefender Ultimate Small Business Security et protégez votre activité contre les cybermenaces. Aucune coordonnée bancaire requise.
Des vulnérabilités connues exploitées pour installer un logiciel légitime
Pour prendre le contrôle des appareils, les pirates se sont appuyés sur plusieurs vulnérabilités déjà documentées. Sur les NAS D-Link ShareCenter, ils ont notamment exploité les failles CVE-2024-3272 et CVE-2024-3273, qui permettent, lorsqu'elles sont combinées, de contourner l'authentification et d'exécuter des commandes à distance.

articles.title: “Nothing has to be”: New York mayor Zohran Mamdani tells citizens to fight back against the AI doom and gloom
articles.summary:
“Nothing has to be”: New York mayor Zohran Mamdani tells citizens to fight back against the AI doom and gloom
Not enough is being done to regulate AI, Mamdani says
- Mayor Zohran Mamdani has urged New Yorkers to push back against AI
- He says there has been a 'complete abdication of federal law' when it comes to regulating the technology
- Mamdani has banned AI use in some schools in New York and has banned AI from being used to generate images on property listings
New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani has urged city residents to push back against the doom and gloom feelings around AI, telling them that “Nothing has to be.”
Speaking at The People’s AI Assembly, hosted by the AI Now Institute in Webster Hall, Manhattan, Mamdani noted there has been a “reckless adoption of technology without any kind of a reckoning with the limitations of that technology.”
“There’s a creep that comes with this, and there’s an intent to overwhelm that leaves people feeling as if there is simply no option,” Mamdani said.
“Reckless adoption of technology”
Federal regulations on AI are few and far between, and are failing to keep pace with the technology, prompting widespread worry that AI will replace jobs and harm education for both New Yorkers and people around the world.
Mamdani’s comment centers around how AI technology is being relentlessly pushed into products, services, education, and elsewhere with people having very little say in how it is used.

articles.title: L’Europe part aussi à la conquête de la Lune : voici OASIS, la future “station-service” de l’ESA sur notre satellite
articles.summary:
L’Agence spatiale européenne (ESA) ne compte pas regarder passer la course à la Lune. Elle prépare sa propre infrastructure, pensée avec des briques européennes de bout en bout.
Alors que la Chine et les États-Unis se tirent la bourre pour implanter la toute première base lunaire permanente, le rôle que jouera l’Europe dans cette conquête est plus que jamais remis en question. Jared Isaacman, patron de la NASA, a été clair : personne n’est garanti d’être partenaire, même s’il s’agit d’alliés de longue date. Dans ce contexte, l’ESA dégaine sa propre carte.
À quoi va servir OASIS, exactement ?
L’agence spatiale vient en effet de présenter OASIS, pour « Outpost for Advanced Scientific Investigation Station », une « station-service » lunaire. Son rôle : fournir l’énergie, les communications et le stockage de données dont les instruments ont besoin pour travailler sur le sol lunaire pendant de très longues périodes, et cela inclut la nuit.
Or, privée de Soleil et soumise à un froid extrême, l’électronique peut y être gravement endommagée. OASIS doit donc capter l’énergie solaire le jour et la stocker dans une batterie. « Il permettra aux charges utiles de fonctionner pendant des années à la surface de la Lune, en activité pendant les jours lunaires et en mode veille pendant les nuits lunaires », étaye l'agence.

articles.title: Future Call of Duty Modern Warfare game could be set in Sydney - Tech Guide
articles.summary:
Australia could become the setting for a future Call of Duty game according to a key game design director who has just landed in Sydney ahead of the launch of Modern Warfare 4.
“It’s such a stunning and beautiful city,” says Alex Norris, Associate Design Director at Infinity Ward – the developer behind the Call of Duty Modern Warfare games.
“I cannot go anywhere without looking at the surroundings and thinking about how to have combat in those surroundings – so you never know.
“At a minimum there would be some inspired elements but yeah, absolutely. Definitely a possibility.”
Norris is part of the Infinity Ward team that has shaped the memorable Call of Duty campaigns for more than a decade but he says Modern Warfare 4 takes a different approach.
“The thing I think is really separating it from Modern Warfare 1, 2, and 3 is that we’ve gone a bit back to our Call of Duty roots with this one,” Norris told Tech Guide.
“It really touches back into the infantry perspective, the grunt cog-in-the-machine approach.
“A lot of the previous Modern Warfare games were really about smaller directed raids going after terrorists in small townhouses or chasing them into the mountains.
“This is a bit of a change-up in that now we’re answering and resolving the storyline of Price and the things that happened to him, pushing the line wherever he needed it, and seeing how that kind of came to a head in Modern Warfare 3, reinvigorating the franchise by bringing us back to our Modern Warfare with a …
